```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# B: Plot volcanos, first for iRBC vs uRBC

```{r volcano plots irbc v urbc, fig.align='center', fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
lfc_threshold <- 1
signif_threshold <- 0.05


temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("10XwVnlcyFjBd8BXgmLFJXajv_kDAa-Mf"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
apara_ivu <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)


apara_ivu <- imap(readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/MAST_deglists_invitro/aparasitemic iRBC v uRBC/mast_deglists_filtmatrices_irbc_v_urbc_aparasitemic_notdownsampled_54.5k_apara_invitro.rds"), ~.x %>%
                   rownames_to_column(., "gene")) %>%
  bind_rows(., .id= "celltype") %>%
  #as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cat = "aparasitemic: PfRBC vs uRBC") %>%
subset(celltype %in% c("CD14 Mono", "NK")) 

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1lFrpG1l9PAJS8Q6AzMSOSFFYvSC3HqqQ"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
para_ivu <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

para_ivu <- imap(readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/MAST_deglists_invitro/parasitemic iRBC v uRBC/mast_deglists_filtmatrices_irbc_v_urbc_parasitemic_notdownsampled_54.5k_apara_invitro.rds"), ~.x %>%
                  rownames_to_column(., "gene")) %>%
  bind_rows(., .id= "celltype") %>%
  #as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cat = "parasitemic: PfRBC vs uRBC") %>%
subset(celltype %in% c("CD14 Mono", "NK")) 


irbc_v_urbc_dge <- rbind(apara_ivu, para_ivu)

invitro_mono_volcano_ivu <- irbc_v_urbc_dge  %>%
  subset(cat %in% c("aparasitemic: PfRBC vs uRBC", "parasitemic: PfRBC vs uRBC")) %>%
  mutate(cat = ifelse(cat=="aparasitemic: PfRBC vs uRBC", "aparasitemic:\nPfRBC vs uRBC", "parasitemic:\nPfRBC vs uRBC")) %>%
  mutate(lfc_neglogpvaladj = abs(avg_log2FC)*-log(p_val_adj)) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, "up in PfRBC", "up in uRBC")) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = ifelse(abs(avg_log2FC) < lfc_threshold | p_val_adj >= signif_threshold, "ns", dot_color)) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = factor(dot_color, levels = c("up in PfRBC", "up in uRBC", "ns"))) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse((p_val_adj < signif_threshold & abs(avg_log2FC) > lfc_threshold) | lfc_neglogpvaladj %in% tail(sort(.$lfc_neglogpvaladj), 2) , gene, "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dot_color), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(signif_threshold), color = "gray20", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), color = "gray20", linetype = "dotted") +
  ylab(bquote(~-log[10] ~ "Adj P value")) +
  xlab(bquote(~log[2] ~ "fold change")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), max.overlaps = 30, size=2, force = 1, force_pull = 5) +
  #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6,6), breaks = c(-6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("up in PfRBC" = "orchid4", "up in uRBC"= "orchid", "ns" = "gray")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(margin=margin(t=17.5,b=-25), hjust = 0.05, vjust = -40),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.05,0.05,0.05,0.05), "null")) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(cols = vars(cat), rows = vars(celltype))


invitro_mono_volcano_ivu -> figs10b

invitro_mono_volcano_ivu
```

# Figure S10d: Characterizing monocytes along pseudotime trajecetory

```{r psueodtime data, fig.align='center', fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4}

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1AMD19Nl_7Y-maIGD2DWTmzhQ_b475Pqn"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
my_hm_mono <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)


# import serialized hm as S4 object and unserialize it
#my_hm_mono <- readRDS("figure6d_mono_pseudotime_trajecotry_heatmap.rds")

my_hm_mono <- unserialize(my_hm_mono)

final_heatmap_stim <- draw(my_hm_mono, heatmap_legend_side="bottom", annotation_legend_side="right",
           legend_grouping = "original",
     annotation_legend_list = lgd_list)

order_cols <- column_order(final_heatmap_stim)
cluster_anno_ordered <- cluster_anno[order_cols,]
cluster_anno_ordered <- cluster_anno_ordered %>%
  mutate("pseudotime cat" = factor(gtools::quantcut(pseudotime, q = 3), labels = c("early", "mid", "late"))) %>%
  dplyr::select("pseudotime cat", everything()) %>%
  mutate(class_treatment = factor(paste0(class, "_",treatment), levels = c("parasitemic_uRBC",
                                                                           "parasitemic_PfRBC",
                                                                           "aparasitemic_uRBC",
                                                                           "aparasitemic_PfRBC")))
mytab_class_treat <- table(cluster_anno_ordered$class_treatment, cluster_anno_ordered$`pseudotime cat`)
mytab_class_treat
chi_res <- chisq.test(mytab_class_treat)

ha_ordered <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = cluster_anno, col = clab, na_col = "lavender",
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                        annotation_legend_param = list(annotation_name_side = "left", nrow = 1),
                        annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 10),
                        show_legend = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE))

ha2 <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = cluster_anno, col = clab, na_col = "lavender",
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                        annotation_legend_param = list(annotation_name_side = "left", nrow = 1),
                        annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 12),
                        show_legend = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE))
my_ha_only <- Heatmap(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = ncol(mat)),
                      top_annotation = ha2,
                      show_column_names = FALSE,
                      clustering_method_columns = NULL,
                      column_order = order(as.numeric(metadata_reduced$log_pseudo_traj)), #add this to order by pseudotime
                      cluster_columns = FALSE,
                      heatmap_legend_param = list(
                        title = "z-score",
                        legend_direction = "horizontal",
                        title_position = "lefttop",
                        legend_width = unit(3, "cm")))

final_ha_only_ordered <- draw(my_ha_only,
                              heatmap_legend_side="bottom",
                              annotation_legend_side="bottom",
                              legend_grouping = "original",
                              annotation_legend_list = lgd_list)

library(gridExtra)
library(gtable)
mytab_grob <- tableGrob(mytab_class_treat, theme = ttheme_default())
footnote <- paste0("χ-squared=", signif(chi_res$statistic, 2), ", p=", signif(chi_res$p.value, 2))
mytab_grob_footnote <- grid.arrange(bottom=footnote, mytab_grob, padding = unit(10, "line"))
my_table <- tern::decorate_grob(mytab_grob, titles = " ", footnotes = footnote, border = FALSE,
                                padding = grid::unit(rep(1, 4), "lines"),
                                margins = grid::unit(c(6,4,4,4), "lines"),
                                outer_margins = grid::unit(c(-1, 17, 1, 21), "cm"),
                                gp_footnotes = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))

figs10d <- plot_grid(grid.grabExpr(draw(final_ha_only_ordered)), my_table, nrow = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tblr")

figs10d
```

Figure S10e

```{r in vitro cytokine data plot, fig.height=5.5, fig.align='center', fig.width=5.5}

#Import cytokine data

temp<-tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1fZahIHtxgwS05KOYyUBXieDJZ4Ht0kwg"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
invitro_ck.dat <-read_excel(file = dl$local_path)

invitro_ck.dat <-read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/Cytokine Data/R21 invitro cytokine 15plex from eve 2025.xlsx")

invitro_ck.dat<- invitro_ck.dat %>%
  dplyr::rename('sample'= '...1') %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("...17", "...18")) %>%
separate_rows(sample, sep = " ") %>% 
  subset(!grepl("PBMCs|sup|lysate|st|18h", sample)) %>%
  mutate(sample= gsub("[()]", "",sample)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id= str_extract(sample, "kali\\d+")) %>%
  mutate(sample= gsub("kali\\d+", "",sample))%>%
dplyr::rename('stim'= 'sample') %>%
  mutate(stim= ifelse(stim=="\r\nURBC", "uRBC", "iRBC")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("stim", "subj_id"), values_to = "conc pg/mL", names_to = "analyte") %>%
  mutate("conc pg/mL"=as.numeric(`conc pg/mL`)) %>%
  mutate(`log10 pg/mL` = log10(`conc pg/mL`+ 1)) 

# import metadatga
temp<-tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1hqfxtz_gomTWa9nfzT-3M9dMwbapRl8D"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
pheno.dat <-readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

# modify and merge with cytokine data
cytokinedata <- pheno.dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-"subj_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename('subj_id' = 'Subject') %>%
  subset(subj_id %in% invitro_ck.dat$subj_id) %>%
  left_join(invitro_ck.dat, by="subj_id")


# add pairing information

my_comparisons <- list("pair_1" = c("kali0585", "kali0593"), 
                       "pair_2" = c("kali0613", "kali0612"),
                       "pair_3" = c("kali0647", "kali0651") 
                       ) 
my_comparisons <- bind_rows(my_comparisons, .id = "pairing") 
my_comparisons <- t(my_comparisons) %>% 
                      as.data.frame()
colnames(my_comparisons) <- c("aparasitemic","parasitemic")
my_comparisons_df <- my_comparisons %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "pairing") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("aparasitemic","parasitemic"), names_to = "class", values_to = "subj_id")


cytokinedata <- cytokinedata %>%
  left_join(my_comparisons_df, by="subj_id") %>%
  mutate(stim = ifelse(stim== "iRBC", "PfRBC", stim))

# create matrix of values
cytokinedata$sub_stim <- paste0(cytokinedata$subj_id, "_", cytokinedata$stim)

ck.mat <- cytokinedata %>%
  dplyr::select(c(`conc pg/mL`, sub_stim, analyte)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(., names_from = sub_stim, values_from = `conc pg/mL`) %>%
  #as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("analyte") %>%
  as.matrix()

# scale and center matrix
ck.mat <- t(scale(t(ck.mat),  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))

ck.mat[is.infinite(ck.mat)] <- NA
# annotations
ck.annot <- cytokinedata %>%
  filter(analyte=="IL-4")

cluster_anno <- data.frame(subject = factor(ck.annot$subj_id),
                           culture = factor(ck.annot$stim),
                           class = factor(ck.annot$class))
                           #sub_stim= factor(ck.annot$sub_stim)


rownames(cluster_anno) <- colnames(ck.mat)

clab <- list("subject" = c("kali0585" = "#f46d43", "kali0593" = "#1B5E20", "kali0612" = "#fdae61", "kali0613" ="#abdda4",  "kali0647" = "#AD1457", "kali0651" = "#66c2a5"),
             "class" = c("aparasitemic" = "#58a4cb", "parasitemic"= "#e41a1c"),
             "culture" = c("uRBC" = "orchid1", "PfRBC"= "orchid3"))

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = cluster_anno, na_col = "darkgrey",
                        col = clab,
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                        annotation_legend_param = list(annotation_name_side = "left", nrow = 1),
                        annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 10),
                        show_legend = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE))



lgd_list <- list(lgd1 = Legend(labels = c("aparasitemic", "parasitemic"), legend_gp = gpar(fill = c( "#58a4cb", "#e41a1c")), title = "class", type = "grid"),
                 lgd2 = Legend(labels = c("uRBC", "PfRBC"), legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("orchid1", "orchid3")), title = "treatment", type = "grid"))

col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-max(abs(ck.mat)), 0, max(abs(ck.mat))), c("blue", "white", "red"))

my_hm_ck <- Heatmap(ck.mat,
                 top_annotation = ha,
                 show_column_names = FALSE,
                 #clustering_method_columns = NULL, #add this to order by pseudotime
                 cluster_columns = F,
                 column_split = cluster_anno$class,
                 row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                 column_title = "subjects",
                 column_title_side = "bottom",
                 row_title = "Z-scored cytokine levels",
                 row_title_side = "right",
                 width = ncol(ck.mat)*unit(5, "mm"), 
    height = nrow(ck.mat)*unit(5, "mm"),
                 heatmap_legend_param = list(
                   title = "z-score",
                   legend_direction = "vertical", 
                    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical"),
                   #title_position = "lefttop",
                   legend_width = unit(3, "cm")))



draw(my_hm_ck, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side ="bottom")

figs10e <- grid.grabExpr(draw(my_hm_ck, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side ="bottom"))
```

# Figure S10g: Cytokine heatmap showing fold changes

```{r invitro ck FCs, fig.align='center', fig.width= 6.5, fig.height=5.5}

temp<-tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1fZahIHtxgwS05KOYyUBXieDJZ4Ht0kwg"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
invitro_ck.dat <-read_excel(file = dl$local_path)

invitro_ck.dat <-read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/Cytokine Data/R21 invitro cytokine 15plex from eve 2025.xlsx")

invitro_ck.dat_fc<- invitro_ck.dat %>%
  dplyr::rename('sample'= '...1') %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("...17", "...18")) %>%
separate_rows(sample, sep = " ") %>% 
  subset(!grepl("PBMCs|sup|lysate|st|18h", sample)) %>%
  mutate(sample= gsub("[()]", "",sample)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id= str_extract(sample, "kali\\d+")) %>%
  mutate(sample= gsub("kali\\d+", "",sample))%>%
dplyr::rename('stim'= 'sample') %>%
  mutate(stim= ifelse(stim=="\r\nURBC", "uRBC", "iRBC")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("stim", "subj_id"), values_to = "conc pg/mL", names_to = "analyte") %>%
  mutate("conc pg/mL"=as.numeric(`conc pg/mL`)) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, analyte) %>%
  mutate(foldchange_conc = log2(`conc pg/mL`[stim == "iRBC"] / `conc pg/mL`[stim == "uRBC"]))  %>%
  subset(stim=="iRBC") %>% # prior to removing iRBC, check that the values are correct
  select(-stim)


# modify and merge with cytokine data
cytokinedata_fc <- pheno.dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-"subj_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename('subj_id' = 'Subject') %>%
  subset(subj_id %in% invitro_ck.dat_fc$subj_id) %>%
  left_join(invitro_ck.dat_fc, by="subj_id")


# add pairing information

my_comparisons <- list("pair_1" = c("kali0585", "kali0593"), 
                       "pair_2" = c("kali0613", "kali0612"),
                       "pair_3" = c("kali0647", "kali0651") 
                       ) 
my_comparisons <- bind_rows(my_comparisons, .id = "pairing") 
my_comparisons <- t(my_comparisons) %>% 
                      as.data.frame()
colnames(my_comparisons) <- c("aparasitemic","parasitemic")
my_comparisons_df <- my_comparisons %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "pairing") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("aparasitemic","parasitemic"), names_to = "class", values_to = "subj_id")


cytokinedata_fc <- cytokinedata_fc %>%
  left_join(my_comparisons_df, by="subj_id")

ck.mat_fc <- cytokinedata_fc %>%
  dplyr::select(c(foldchange_conc, subj_id, analyte)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(., names_from = subj_id, values_from = foldchange_conc) %>%
  #as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("analyte") %>%
  as.matrix()

# scale and center matrix
#ck.mat <- t(scale(t(ck.mat),  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
#ck.mat[is.nan(ck.mat)] <- NA
#ck.mat <- ck.mat[-6,]


ck.mat_fc[is.infinite(ck.mat_fc)] <- NA

# annotations
ck.annot <- cytokinedata_fc %>%
  filter(analyte=="GM-CSF")

clab <- list("subject" = c("kali0585" = "#f46d43", "kali0593" = "#1B5E20", "kali0612" = "#fdae61", "kali0613" ="#abdda4",  "kali0647" = "#AD1457", "kali0651" = "#66c2a5"),
             "class" = c("aparasitemic" = "#58a4cb", "parasitemic"= "#e41a1c"),
             "culture" = c("uRBC" = "orchid1", "PfRBC"= "orchid3"))

cluster_anno <- data.frame(subject = factor(ck.annot$subj_id),
                           #culture = factor(ck.annot$stim),
                           class = factor(ck.annot$class))

rownames(cluster_anno) <- colnames(ck.mat_fc)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = cluster_anno, na_col = "darkgrey",
                        col = clab,
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                        annotation_legend_param = list(annotation_name_side = "left", nrow = 1),
                        annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 10),
                        show_legend = c(FALSE, TRUE))

col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-max(abs(ck.mat_fc)), 0, max(abs(ck.mat_fc))), c("blue", "white", "red"))

my_hm_ck_fc <- Heatmap(ck.mat_fc,
                    top_annotation = ha,
                    show_column_names = FALSE,
                    #clustering_method_columns = NULL, #add this to order by pseudotime
                    cluster_columns = F,
                    column_split = cluster_anno$class,
                    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                    column_title = "subjects",
                    column_title_side = "bottom",
                    row_title = "log2 fold change (PfRBC/uRBC)",
                    width = ncol(ck.mat_fc)*unit(6, "mm"), 
    height = nrow(ck.mat_fc)*unit(6, "mm"),
                    row_title_side = "right",
                    heatmap_legend_param = list(
                      title = "log2FC",
                     legend_direction = "vertical", 
                    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical"),
                      legend_width = unit(3, "cm")))

draw(my_hm_ck_fc, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side ="bottom")

figs10f <- grid.grabExpr(draw(my_hm_ck_fc, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side ="bottom"))
```
